global_policy: These are research/screening sources, not a measured nk certification for the user deposition process.

No silent extrapolation outside an independently stated n or k characterization interval. Explicit source-model continuation or exported-zero branches are allowed for algorithm research when labeled, but do not establish measured zero absorption.
Do not combine n from one process and k from another under one calibrated material identity.
Scalar effective-isotropic film treatment is an assumption; no full tensor validation at39–51 degrees was located.

The author spreadsheets contain numerical n,k across their entire export ranges. Blank derived k fields are our conservative qualification choice, not an assertion that the original author files lack numbers. The original numerical k, including exported zeros, is retained in a separate column.
